title: Suspicious authentication activity from external source IP
description: VPN security alert: source IP 185.1.2.3 generated repeated failed authentication attempts followed by a successful login. Analyst needs SIEM telemetry to determine whether this IP produced authentication or network activity during the alert window.
investigation_objective: Determine whether source IP 185.1.2.3 generated authentication failures, successful logins, or related network activity in the Splunk SIEM during the last 60 minutes. Use splunk_search with SIEM queries scoped to this IP and time window before concluding.
